title: Nice and shiney
text: Nice and shiney. These are nice heavy sturdy, forks. They fit comfortably in your hand. I love the fact there are no patterns on these 2 collect dirt like some patterns due So it makes them very easy to wash. The only difference in these forks is they are just a bit longer Than the fork compartment In my drawer holder. Not a big deal tho.
